The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) intends to issue a brand-name call under the DHS Strategic Sourcing Vehicle (SSV) Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) Medical Supplies II, referred to as MedS2, for Stryker LIFEPAK CR2 Automated External Defibrillators and associated

ts limiting the requirement to the Stryker LIFEPAK CR2 brand-name product and associated accessories pursuant to RFO 16.507-7. This justification does not authorize award to a single BPA holder without competition. The resulting RFQ/call will be competed among eligible DHS Strategic Source Vehicle Blanket Purchase Agreement Medical Supplies II (MedS2) BPA holders capable of providing the required Stryker brand-name supplies. Only the Stryker LIFEPAK CR2 brand-name product can meet the Government’s minimum needs; however, multiple eligible BPA holders may be capable of providing that product. FEMA intends to procure a brand-name specification for Stryker LIFEPAK CR2 Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) and associated accessories. These environments may lack municipal power, reliable local Wi-Fi

ailable, unreliable, or restricted. AEDs relying on local Wi-Fi or manual data transfer would require physical inspections and would create readiness gaps across geographically dispersed field locations. This minimizes or eliminates pre-shock pauses and increases compression time during cardiac emergencies. This capability is essential to support effective emergency cardiac response for deployed FEMA personnel. c) High-energy biphasic shock output. The Stryker LIFEPAK CR2 provides escalating shock delivery up to 360 joules for hard- to-defibrillate patients.
